title: streamTracer
body:
## streamTracer

Integrates streamlines of a steady vector field from the points of a separate seed dataset and returns polygonal data made of polylines. Connect the flow dataset to input and any point-producing node (line, sphere, a slice) to seed; every seed point starts a trace. Input point arrays are interpolated onto the lines and ParaView adds IntegrationTime, Vorticity, Rotation and AngularVelocity point arrays and a ReasonForTermination cell array. Point vectors are interpolated along the trace. A cell vector array (association CELLS) is traced as constant within each cell, but ParaView's input domain also requires some three-component point array on the input, so a cell-only input fails INPUT_DOMAIN_MISMATCH at update. Convert cell-centred CFD velocity with cellToPoint for the usual smooth traces. The integrator stays at ParaView's Runge-Kutta 4-5 with step lengths in cell lengths. Use pvStreamTracerWithCustomSource to change the integrator, step unit or terminal speed, and pvStreamTracer for ParaView's built-in seed shapes.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- These are instantaneous streamlines at the selected time, not pathlines or particle tracks through changing timesteps.
- maximumLength (Schemaxis default 20) is an absolute arc length in dataset units, not a fraction of the domain; scale it to your geometry, or lines in a large domain stop early.
- Empty or truncated lines usually mean seeds outside the flow cells, the wrong vector array, or speed below ParaView's terminal speed (1e-12). ReasonForTermination tells why each line stopped: 1 left the domain, 4 maximum length, 5 maximum steps, 6 terminal speed.
- Schemaxis's serial native acceptance run (examples/schemaxis/extended-coverage.json) executes this operation once, tracing a uniform analytic velocity from a line of seeds; it does not check this operation's output values, so inspect the result on your own data.

Native constructor: `StreamTracerWithCustomSource`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | The updated dataset containing the velocity vector. This is the flow field, not the seed line. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `seed` | A separate node whose points start the streamlines, usually a Line source. Select the line node ID here. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":[],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vectors` | Two entries: the association token and the vector array name. For point-centred velocity U use ["POINTS", "U"]. Select a vector, not its scalar magnitude. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `direction` | FORWARD follows the vector orientation, BACKWARD goes against it, and BOTH traces from each seed in both directions. | `{"type":"enum","values":["FORWARD","BACKWARD","BOTH"]}` | `"FORWARD"` | `"FORWARD"` |
| `maximumLength` | Upper limit on the arc length of each integrated trajectory. Integration may stop earlier at a dataset boundary, low speed or the step limit. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true}` | `20` | `20` |
| `maximumSteps` | Upper limit on integration steps for each streamline. Reaching this limit can truncate a trajectory before its maximum length. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":1}` | `2000` | `2000` |
| `initialStep` | Initial integration step size. Its units depend on native IntegrationStepUnit; it is not necessarily a distance in metres. The curated operation leaves the integrator and step unit at native defaults. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true}` | `0.2` | `0.2` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "streamTracer",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input",
    "seed": "UPSTREAM_seed"
  },
  "options": {
    "vectors": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE",
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
